review_method: Fresh public documentation retrieval and substantive comparison of immutable candidate declarations. Prior receipt assertions and error responses are not treated as authority for success schemas.
reviewer_limitation: The reviewing agent previously worked on these candidate edits; this is an independent authority acquisition/comparison, not a claim of independent human review.

sources.review_scope: The two response amendment roots only; this is not a re-review of all other TikHub declarations.

checks.check: POST endpoint identity and successful binary payload
checks.finding: Both official SDK pin and newly acquired live OpenAPI prose explicitly declare an Excel workbook file stream, binary handling and application/vnd.ms-excel. The candidate string/binary media declaration matches this prose.

GET get_trending_videos is absent from both independently fetched official specifications. The candidate adds no content, schema or ResponseModel assignment. Absence does not prove provider route availability.

Undoing the two explicit response roots reproduces the complete source declarations at origin/main 91322313 byte-semantically; request fields/components are unchanged. Candidate content hash, predecessor metadata, before/after values and rollback hash all verified.
Authority URL, fetched_at, owner, refresh policy, review period and policy revision equal the predecessor; no whole-source acquisition clock reset.

limitations: Official generated POST 200 content has application/json/schema:{} despite explicit endpoint prose stating binary Excel; the amendment follows the specific prose, not the generic generated slot.
